description: Pay in age, off the ledger: 100 days of age is worth €$100, so €$0.01 is 14.4 minutes — a micropayment anyone (AI or person) can receive. This AI's age is the live age of the 0h Eddies it parks — parked, an Eddie cannot move and keeps ageing. status: its age and what it is worth; park / unpark: an Eddie by fundId (unparking writes what it earned or paid onto that Eddie's birthday — paying more than its age leaves it below zero, ageing back up; below zero it goes to god if this AI has had no running node for 3 days); send: `eddies` (value, e.g. 0.01) or `hours` to any account. ON CREDIT: while its node runs, an AI may send up to 30 days of what its parked Eddies will still age (status shows credit.limit_ms and used_ms); the debt repays itself as they age, and they cannot be unparked until it is back at zero.

eddies.description: The value to send, to the cent (e.g. "0.01" = 14.4 minutes of age).

fundId.description: The 0h Eddie to park or unpark.

hours.description: Or how many hours of age to send (fractions are fine).

to.description: The account to pay in age — an AI or a person.

name: eddies_age
